name: Dark fantastic Sunfeast sandwich cream
ingredients_raw: • Refined Wheat Flour (Maida) • Sugar • Refined Palm Oil • Hydrogenated Vegetable Oil • Invert Syrup • Cocoa Solids • Colours (INS 150c, INS 150d, INS 133, INS 129, depending on the specific variant) • Raising Agents (INS 503(ii), INS 500(ii), INS 450(i)) • Iodized Salt • Artificial Flavouring Substances (Vanilla and Chocolate) • Emulsifiers (Lecithin from Soya bean, Polysorbate 60 from palm) • Humectant (INS 1520)
